title: Merge Feature Branch and Clean Up
description: Merge `feature/profile-page` into `main`, verify all files exist on `main`, and delete the merged feature branch.
steps: In `hcc-git-practice`, switch to the receiving branch: `git switch main`
Verify your status: `git status` — confirm you are on `main` and working tree is clean
Merge the feature branch: `git merge feature/profile-page`
Observe the output: notice 'Fast-forward' and that `profile.md` is now part of `main`!
Inspect history: `git log --oneline` — observe the feature commit is now in `main`'s history
Delete the feature branch locally: `git branch -d feature/profile-page`
Push updated `main` to GitHub: `git push origin main`
expected_output: Terminal confirms successful merge, branch deleted, and `profile.md` pushed to GitHub `main`.
tips: Always remember: to merge Branch A into `main`, you must BE ON `main` when running `git merge BranchA`!
`-d` (lowercase) will only delete a branch if it has already been safely merged, preventing accidental work loss.
